connections.edgeLabel: released files placed in DEFE 24 and DEFE 31
connections.label: The National Archives / MoD UFO File Release Programme (2008-2013)
connections.note: Every tranche page lists the piece numbers transferred; the final June 2013 tranche is DEFE 24/2448-2465 and 2623-2629.

desc: DEFE 24 (Ministry of Defence: Defence Secretariat Branches: Registered Files) and DEFE 31 (Ministry of Defence: Air Secretariat: Registered Files) are the two National Archives record series into which the MoD's UFO holdings were placed. The released piece numbers are enumerable and citable: DEFE 24/1926-1930 (October 2008); DEFE 24/1938 and DEFE 31/176-181 (March 2009); DEFE 24/1948, 1959-1965, 1970-1976, 2086 (August 2009); DEFE 24/1973, 1978, 1982, 1983, 1991-1993, 1995, 1996, 1998, 2001, 2004, 2012-2015, 2042, 2045 (August 2010); DEFE 24/1958, 2006, 2019, 2020, 2031, 2033-2035, 2047, 2056, 2057, 2060, 2064-2072, 2075, 2076, 2081, 2082, 2091, 2094 and DEFE 31/182-188 (August 2011); DEFE 24/1984, 1985, 1987, 2005, 2043, 2061, 2073, 2074, 2077-2080, 2083, 2084, 2087-2090, 2093 and DEFE 31/189-194 (July 2012); DEFE 24/2448-2465 and 2623-2629 (June 2013). The wider UK holding also includes AIR 2 and AIR 20 Air Ministry files and the Prime Minister's series PREM 11/855, which contains Churchill's July 1952 minute demanding to know 'what all this stuff about flying saucers' amounts to.
